# cdnpro_property (Resource)

A CDN Pro property together with its configuration. The API keeps configuration in immutable numbered versions; this resource hides that. Changing a configuration attribute patches the latest version in place when it has never been deployed, and otherwise creates a new version. Creating a version never deploys it: use `cdnpro_deployment` for that.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cdnpro_property" "main" {
  name        = "example-site"
  description = "Main production property"

  hostnames      = ["www.example.com", "example.com"]
  edge_logic     = file("${path.module}/edge-logic/main.dsl")
  syntax_version = 1

  origins = [
    {
      name               = "primary"
      servers            = ["origin.example.com:80,443"]
      supported_protocol = "https"
      verify_origin      = true
      host_header        = "origin.example.com"
      direct_connection  = "noDirect"
    }
  ]

  tls_certificate_id     = cdnpro_certificate.prod.id
  tls_min_version        = "1.2"
  tls_max_version        = "1.3"
  redirect_http_to_https = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `edge_logic` (String) Edge Logic (NGINX-style DSL). Passed through unparsed; syntax errors surface at apply time with the API's error code.
- `hostnames` (List of String) Hostnames served by this property.
- `name` (String) Property name. Must be unique within the account.
- `origins` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--origins))
- `syntax_version` (Number) Edge Logic syntax version. Currently always `1`.

### Optional

- `access_control_rules` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_control_rules))
- `allow_protocol_downgrade` (Boolean)
- `beian_content_type` (Number) Beian content type code. Required when `has_beian` is true.
- `cache_key_hostname` (String)
- `cache_key_uri` (String)
- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `disable_cert_automation` (Boolean)
- `disable_http2` (Boolean)
- `enable_http3` (Boolean)
- `enable_ipv6_origin` (Boolean)
- `enable_ocsp_stapling` (Boolean)
- `extra_service_ports` (Attributes) Extra HTTP/HTTPS service ports. Values must be from the account's allowed list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--extra_service_ports))
- `follow_client_ip_version` (String)
- `has_beian` (Boolean) Whether the hostnames hold an ICP Beian licence.
- `real_time_log` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--real_time_log))
- `redirect_http_to_https` (String) `true`/`false`, or one of `302`, `307`, `308` to redirect with that status code. HCL booleans are accepted and converted to strings.
- `scheme_in_cache_key` (Boolean)
- `tls_0rtt` (Boolean)
- `tls_certificate_id` (String) Certificate served to clients over HTTPS (`cdnpro_certificate.id`).
- `tls_certificate_id1` (String) Second certificate of the other key type (RSA vs EC). Requires `tls_certificate_id`.
- `tls_ciphers` (String)
- `tls_max_version` (String)
- `tls_min_version` (String)
- `tls_session_timeout` (Number)
- `video_seek` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--video_seek))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Property ID.
- `latest_version` (Number) Number of the newest configuration version. Reference this from `cdnpro_deployment`.
- `version_in_production` (Number) Version currently deployed to production, if any.
- `version_in_staging` (Number) Version currently deployed to staging, if any.

<a id="nestedatt--origins"></a>
### Nested Schema for `origins`

Required:

- `name` (String) Origin name, unique within the property.
- `servers` (List of String) Origin servers as `host`, `host:httpPort` or `host:httpPort,httpsPort`, optionally followed by ` backup` or ` weight=N`.

Optional:

- `authentication` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--origins--authentication))
- `direct_connection` (String)
- `host_header` (String)
- `keep_alive_timeout` (Number)
- `max_connections` (Number)
- `peer_failure_timeout` (Attributes) Peer failure detection. Set `disabled = true` to send the API's literal `"off"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--origins--peer_failure_timeout))
- `peer_selection_algorithm` (String)
- `shield` (String) Origin shield ID from the shields API.
- `supported_protocol` (String)
- `tls_certificate_id` (String) Client certificate presented to the origin (`cdnpro_certificate.id`).
- `verify_origin` (Boolean)

Optional:

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import by property ID (from the API's Location header or the CDN Pro portal).
terraform import cdnpro_property.main 5f1e2d3c4b5a69788796a5b4
```
